visual.detail: Manager must inspect all views for placement, proportions, missing/extra parts and visible intersections
visual.observation: Front, top and iso inspected. Square backing plate with a 180 mm drum, one continuous seam groove round the drum, and a smooth spherical-cap dome above it. A single straight 30 mm shutter slit runs on one meridian from the near rim of the drum, over the apex, and stops short of the far rim; top view confirms it is straight, parallel-sided and centred. The telescope tube sits in the slit at 45 degrees on a pier and two fork arms, all fused to the slit walls; front view shows the tube standing clear of the pier with no floating or detached geometry. No cone, hood or buttress remains. No missing, extra, misplaced or intersecting parts.
